facts.fact: Le Sahel reports the World Bank-backed WURI project is developing a National Population Register (RNP) to be interoperable with the civil-status and nationality registers, run by the new ANEI agency.

systems.owner: Service Central de Production de la CNIB

NER.note: The only figure is 66% of births declared, which is birth registration, not people enrolled in the ID system.
States 66% of births declared but no ID number given at birth.
Describes project support to the agency (equipment, staff, mini data centre and SOC) but not who operates or maintains a system in service.
No public register is said to use the national ID number.

facts.fact: Le Sahel reports the restructured WURI project is building a National Population Register (RNP) to identify and authenticate individuals, with enrolment to start in Niamey's five arrondissements, and the ANEI agency created by decree of 22 April 2026.
